svg.title: Five signatures of 3D genome architecture in Hi-C maps
svg.desc: Original vector teaching figure with five separate panels: A/B compartment plaid, contact domains, domain boundaries, focal loop-like enrichments, and stripes. Each shows a conceptual chromatin diagram and independent synthetic contact map. Not experimental data.
svg.text: Recognize the pattern. Then question what the assay can establish.
All coordinates and signals are illustrative. Chromatin cartoons are conceptual—not 1:1 reconstructions of matrices.
